def ProverRwRng.StateOnlyAttemptSecrets.generate_with : [ProverRwRng.ErasureFns] →
  {P : Type} →
    ProverRwRng.Draw64 P →
      Aeneas.Std.Array Aeneas.Std.U8 32#usize →
        P →
          Aeneas.Std.Result
            (P ×
              Aeneas.Std.core.result.Result ProverRwRng.StateOnlyAttemptSecrets
                ProverRwRng.StateOnlyAttemptEntropyError) :=
fun [ProverRwRng.ErasureFns] {P} Draw64Inst mask_nonce provider => do
  let b ← ProverRwRng.entropy_nonzero32 mask_nonce
  if b = true then
      ProverRwRng.StateOnlyAttemptSecrets.generate_with_loop Draw64Inst mask_nonce provider
        ProverRwRng.ENTROPY_RETRY_LIMIT 0#usize
    else
      Aeneas.Std.Result.ok
        (provider, Aeneas.Std.core.result.Result.Err ProverRwRng.StateOnlyAttemptEntropyError.RepeatedZeroBlock)
